sources.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/checkpointService.ts
sources.finding: Checkpoint pins a clean current commit and branch; stale checks whether the commit object resolves through git cat-file -e, not whether it remains reachable from HEAD. This is a diff baseline, not revision approval.

sources.title: DockTerm: src/renderer/src/components/review/ReviewPanel.tsx
sources.finding: Human review panel selects last commit/session/checkpoint, displays file deltas and opens Monaco diffs, with stage and commit navigation. No approval queue or review-comments schema.

sources.title: DockTerm: src/main/security.ts
sources.finding: Packaged renderer blocks remote content and permissions and uses a restricted app origin. This is UI containment, not sandboxing arbitrary terminal programs.

sources.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/pathJail.ts
sources.finding: File IPC canonicalizes symlinks and checks project-root containment. PTY commands remain host-authorized and are not jailed by this function.

sources.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/gitTrust.ts
sources.finding: Git command-running repository configuration is gated by session-local trust; automatic read-only commands receive hardening overrides.

sources.title: DockTerm: src/main/ipc/register.ts
sources.finding: Internal Electron IPC checks trusted sender, window role and Zod request schemas; this is not a public remote API or human RBAC.

sources.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/usageService.ts
sources.locator: getUsageSnapshot, startUsageWatcher; usageCore.ts buildSnapshot and budgets
sources.finding: Local Claude transcript token counts aggregate by model/project/time; inferred plan budgets are estimates. Default status-line source avoids background transcript scans.

sources.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/usageCaptureService.ts
sources.finding: Optional local status-line wrapper saves Claude-reported rate/context/model/cost values in userData; no model API tokens or network are used by this reader.

sources.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/updateChecker.ts
sources.locator: checkForUpdates, download flow and GitHub URLs
sources.finding: On-by-default toggleable GitHub release polling restricts installer asset URLs; automatic installation requires an available valid SHA512 and verifies it. Missing checksum opens the release page rather than proceeding automatically. Functional update traffic is distinct from analytics.

sources.title: DockTerm: src/main/services/ptyFlow.ts
sources.finding: PTY output batching pauses at a high unacknowledged-byte watermark and resumes below a low watermark. This is display backpressure, not agent compute scheduling.

sources.title: DockTerm: src/renderer/src/App.tsx
sources.finding: Electron React workspace contains terminal tabs/splits, local chat reading and composer, side panels and shortcuts. No browser/mobile/editor client entry point.
